quest.title: The Culling of the Worms: Conclusion
quest.description: Near the meeting spot with the two scholars, you once again hear the sound of a distant quarrel...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: ...So as far as the conclusion is concerned, we've made a convincing case for using the Wenutslayer Cannon to get rid of the Wenut, right?

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: That's different! Don't give me that "told you so" look!

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: #Ah, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} Adventurer! Listen to me! I've found out what the cause is!

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: The frequent activity of the Wenut underground had caused a disturbance in the Elemental Energy in this region.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: This Energy, in turn, affects the behavior of the Wenut, causing them to start running amok on the surface, further exacerbating the environmental imbalance.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: The abnormality in the charging device's efficiency was also due to the disturbance of Elemental Energy in the environment.

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: I knew the machine that I designed would never break down so easily!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you don't consider the surrounding environment, wouldn't that be a design problem?

choices.text: And since the cause is overactive Wenut...

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: So, after going around in several circles, we're back to where we started?

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Knowing what to do and knowing why you should do it are two different things. As a researcher, you couldn't even grasp that? And that isn't even the end of it.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Normally, nature sets limits on the ecology and behavior of populations to keep the environment stable.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: The chaotic Elemental Energy disrupts this balance, which makes the Wenut extremely active...

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: As long as we can find a way to return the elemental environment to its normal state, we can reduce Wenut activity. After a while, the balance should restore itself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Redirect the flow of Elemental Energy? But how do we do that?

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Well, as long as we figure out where the strongest concentration of Elemental Energy is, we'll be able to direct the flow of that energy with a device...

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: ...We unclog the flow of energy, and nature should take care of the rest.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: I've already calculated the location of the node. It's somewhere around here. As for a device that can redirect the flow of the energy, we already have one...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You mean the Wenutslayer Cannon?

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Precisely. The Wenutslayer Cannon can channel the surrounding Elemental Energy before discharging it all in one go.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Next, we just have to set up the Wenutslayer Cannon and go through the same process as yesterday.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: There may also be monsters and Wenut that will be drawn to the weapon during this time... Heh... perhaps a small reduction in their numbers would help expedite the natural balance.

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: ...So as far as the conclusion is concerned, we still have to use the Wenutslayer Cannon to shoot at monsters, right?

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Ugh! Don't give me that "told you so" look!

choices.text: Is the solution to just keep fighting more Wenut?
What are you squabbling about this time?
